elements.name: Scope
elements.text: Solar power and energy storage in the Sultanate of Oman
lines: Solar power and energy storage in the Sultanate of Oman

elements.name: Body-1
elements.text: AFAQ for Energy & Integrated Business is an Omani company based in Muscat. It works in solar power, energy storage and the electrical systems that go with them.
lines: AFAQ for Energy & Integrated Business is an Omani company
based in Muscat. It works in solar power, energy storage and the
electrical systems that go with them.

elements.name: Body-2
elements.text: The company designs photovoltaic systems, supplies their components, installs them and brings them into operation, at sizes ranging from building systems to project plants.
